physical_invariants: Exactly one current location per entity; a tube contains a slide and a particle charge without replacing their identities
Each station handoff requires an actual MOVE receipt with source/destination support evidence
Cure state and geometry belong to a specific specimen, not a generic batch name
A coating or challenge appends a state transition; it does not create a newly independent replicate
Detached beads and trap remnants are child entities of a terminally disassembled array
An intact PUF key cannot be reused after destructive bead-removal/SEM preparation
Reuse cycles retain same trap parent and separate charge/cycle/attempt records
Four-granule key membership and shared-bead overlaps stay explicit
Baseline and postchallenge sites pair by stable slide/trap/granule IDs, not nearest visual point alone
Missing/detached contact sites retain assigned slots; denominator changes require explicit derivation
record_invariants: Raw files immutable and acquisition-linked, with timestamps, source object, device ID and settings
Derived records list all raw parents, algorithm version, calibration and selection/exclusion rules
Failed/missed/ambiguous trials persist; retries append attempt IDs
Unknown is not zero and source result is never an acquired value
At most one physical event per claimed event receipt; reusing one video frame cannot invent independent trials
